what: 30 random points that the Mk1.5 pipeline (verify v2, min hit rate 0.7) tracks but the reference tracker (HyDaT/Polytrack) has nowhere within 50 units; judged by eye from 120 px crops (disputed_points_v0.7.jpg, red circle = our point)
conclusion: 67-83% of measured false alarms are real bees the reference does not follow (it tracks one bee per honeybee video). Measured false-alarm rate 0.526 -> estimated true false-alarm rate ~0.09-0.18.
